title: Management SaaS: The End of Chaos in Spreadsheets
body:
Does your company coordinate operations worth thousands of euros based on a 'master Excel' that is passed around by email, full of infinite tabs, and with a constant risk of being lost or corrupted?

It's the natural life cycle: a business grows faster than its tools. What was once a useful spreadsheet for keeping track has today become an unmanageable monster. Information is duplicated, no one knows which is the true latest version of the document, critical deadlines are missed, and security is non-existent: any employee could take the entire database on a USB stick.

Why a Standard Commercial ERP Is Not the Answer

When administrative disorder erupts, the usual reaction is to hire a generic ERP or management software. The problem is that these platforms force you to change your consolidated workflows to adapt to their system. You end up paying very expensive monthly licenses for each added user, only to use barely 10% of functionalities that do not solve the real complexity of your day-to-day operations.

Our Solution: Comprehensive Development with All the Studio's Talent

To build your company's operational brain, we deploy our full team (UI/UX usability specialists, data architecture, backend, and cybersecurity). We analyze your current processes and develop an exclusive Management SaaS for you, mirroring your way of working while eliminating friction.

  1. Intuitive UI/UX Interface: Our visual team designs dashboards that your staff will love to use. We implement Kanban boards with 'drag & drop' technology to make project management extremely visual and have a zero-minute learning curve.
  2. Automated Business Logic: Backend engineers program the core to work for you. We automate task creation, deadline control, and the sending of smart reminders so that no commercial or logistical deadline is missed.
  3. Surgical Security and Access Roles: We protect your most valuable asset. We apply data encryption and configure access roles: each employee can only view and edit the information strictly necessary for their position. Goodbye to data theft or accidental deletion.

The Real Impact on Your Operations

  • Total Team Alignment: All your staff work on a single source of truth in real-time, accessible from any device and anywhere in the world.
  • Total Technological Ownership: As it is a proprietary development, there are no license costs based on the number of users. If your staff grows from 10 to 100 employees, your software costs do not increase by a single cent.
  • Multiplied Efficiency: What previously required hours of calls, emails, and cross-referencing Excels, is now monitored at a glance on an executive control panel that loads in milliseconds.
